semiconductor_relevance: High — LINTEC Advanced Technologies provides specialized equipment and materials crucial for semiconductor back-end production processes.
summary: LINTEC Advanced Technologies (Europe) GmbH specializes in providing comprehensive solutions for semiconductor back-end production, focusing on Tape x Equipment. Their offerings include a wide range of tapes and equipment for dicing, grinding, and packaging, tailored to both mass production and niche markets.

regional_presence.Europe: LINTEC has a strong presence in Europe, particularly in Munich and Dresden, ensuring rapid response times and high-quality customer service.
